title: A changed dinner party
passage:
Didn't you reserve a table for six?
A. Yes, but two guests just canceled. B. We close at ten tonight. C. The table is made of wood.
passageZh:
你不是預訂了六人桌嗎？
A. 是的，不過有兩位客人剛取消。
B. 我們今晚十點打烊。
C. 桌子是木製的。
